japan.basis: lyricist 高野辰之 (1947); composer 岡野貞一 (1941). The later of the two deaths is 1947.
japan.test: Japan: both authors died 1967 or earlier, or the work is anonymous and published 1967 or earlier.

us.basis: first published 1912, 尋常小學唱歌 第四學年用.
us.test: US: published 1930 or earlier, or published later with every author dead in 1945 or earlier, because the URAA restored anything still protected in its source country on 1996-01-01.

_licence.verses_permitted_note: The report transcribes the first verse only, so this file carries one verse. More verses need a fresh trip to the source, not a memory.
_licence.note: Derived from data/songs/haru-no-ogawa.json: one item per line, the pieces cut on the word boundaries of the corpus's romaji line aligned onto the kana (a one-kana piece joins the piece before it, a repeated piece is one piece), the verse gloss shown after a miss. Verdicts, credits and the authors' death years are copied from that file. Qualifier: 1912 text only.

items.line: はるの おがわは さらさら ながる

gloss.en: The spring brook runs murmuring, as if whispering to the violets and milk-vetch flowers on its bank: bloom, bloom, sweet-scented and beautifully coloured.
